'''Taanti''' was a [[Weequay]] [[Gender|male]] proprietor that worked as a [[bartender]] at a [[Mos Pelgo saloon|cantina]] in [[Freetown]]. After the [[Battle of Endor]], the [[Mining Collective]] attacked the cantina, killing the townsfolk inside. Taanti escaped with the help of [[Cobb Vanth]], who later [[Liberation of Mos Pelgo|liberated]] the town. Years later, he served [[spotchka]] to Vanth, the [[marshal]] of the town, and to the [[Mandalorian]] [[bounty hunter]] [[Din Djarin]], who had come searching for Vanth. Taanti, along with the people of Mos Pelgo, joined Vanth, Djarin and a local group of [[Tusken Raider]]s to [[Mission to Tatooine (Din Djarin)|kill]] a [[Leviathan krayt dragon|krayt dragon]] that attacked the town.<ref name="Chapter 9" />

Sometime later, he served a drink to Vanth, while Djarin asked the marshal to lead a [[Freetown garrison|garrison]] in assistance of [[Boba Fett]] against the [[Pyke Syndicate]]. Taanti interfered, saying that the town wanted no part of it, and that it was a city folk fight. Shortly after, Vanth asked Taanti to gather men and women of fighting age to meet. Taanti replied that the conflict with the [[Pyke]]s was not the town's problem. Before they could arrange the meeting, Vanth was [[Showdown in Freetown|shot down]] by [[Cad Bane]],<ref name="Chapter 6 BOBF">{{BOBF|Chapter 6: From the Desert Comes a Stranger}}</ref> which convinced Taanti and the town's garrison to join the [[Battle of Mos Espa|battle]]. Freetown's help saved Fett's forces, and eventually they won the battle, driving out the Syndicate off of the planet.<ref name="Chapter 7 BOBF" />

==Personality and traits==
Taanti, like his fellow inhabitants of Mos Pelgo, regarded Tuskens as brutal enemies. When Djarin proposed an alliance between the townsfolk and the Tuskens, Taanti shouted that they were monsters, although eventually they killed the [[Krayt dragon|dragon]] together.<ref name="Chapter 9" />

Taanti thought that the "city folk fight" on [[Mos Espa]] was not the town's problem,<ref name="Chapter 6 BOBF" /> but later joined the fight, in revenge of Vanth, who was shot by Cad Bane.<ref name="Chapter 7 BOBF" />

{{Char-stub}}

==Behind the scenes==
Taanti first appeared in [[Chapter 9: The Marshal|Chapter 9]] of ''[[Star Wars: The Mandalorian]]'' and was portrayed by [[W. Earl Brown]].<ref name="Chapter 9" />
